releaseTitle: ATalk v3.8.0 — Antigravity Cyber-Minimalist Bento Composer (Omni-Dock)
releaseNotes:
• 01 Antigravity Cyber-Minimalist Bento Composer: Floating omni-dock with sub-pixel 0.8dp borders, squircle corners, and backdrop blur.
• 02 Integrated Context Micro-Chips: Real-time badges for 256-GCM cipher status, disappearing burner timer TTL, anonymous admin masking, and 0 dB silent dispatch toggle.
• 03 Clean Modular Rollback: Fully self-contained composable architecture allowing effortless switching or reversion.
• 04 Micro-Spring Touch Dynamics: Haptic spring feedback on send, mic, and attachment triggers.
